gloss: item in good condition; beautiful specimen

definitions.explanation: A secondhand or collectible item that is in excellent condition with minimal signs of use. Commonly used in online marketplace listings and auction sites.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{本|ほん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{美品|びひん}です。
examples.english: This book is in excellent condition.

examples.japanese: {美品|びひん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中古|ちゅうこ}→中古：03479_chuuko⟧⟦カメラ→カメラ：04417_kamera⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{安|やす}く→安い：00464_yasui⟧⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れた→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。
examples.english: I got a used camera in great condition for a low price.

examples.japanese: フリマ⟦アプリ→アプリ：04722_apuri⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧「{美品|びひん}」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{書|か}いてあって→書く：00477_kaku⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、⟦{届|とど}いたら→届く：00899_todoku⟧⟦{傷|きず}だらけ→傷だらけ：26862_kizudarake⟧だったこと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Even when it says 'excellent condition' on the flea market app, there have been times when the item arrived covered in scratches.

notes:
USAGE:
{美品|びひん} is extremely common in Japanese online marketplaces like メルカリ (Mercari), ヤフオク (Yahoo Auctions), and ラクマ (Rakuma). It indicates that a secondhand item has been well cared for and shows little wear.

CONDITION SCALE (common in listings):
- ⟦{新品|しんぴん}→新品：08303_shinpin⟧: brand new
- ⟦{未使用|みしよう}→未使用：21316_mishiyou⟧: unused
- {美品|びひん}: excellent condition
- {良品|りょうひん}: good condition
- ⟦{難|なん}→難：00452_nan⟧あり: has flaws/defects
- ジャンク: junk, for parts

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {美品|びひん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中古|ちゅうこ}→中古：03479_chuuko⟧〜 (secondhand ~ in excellent condition)
- {美品|びひん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧お{探|さが}し⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{方|かた}→方：10665_kata⟧ (for those looking for items in excellent condition)
- ⟦{状態|じょうたい}→状態：03345_joutai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{美品|びひん} (condition is excellent)
